response_corrections.NH_original_heading: MS_Response was confirmed by the author to denote UV response
response_corrections.base_label: CsOH/2 was confirmed by the author to denote CsOH

initialization.sampling: uniform without replacement; the resulting conditions were run before the first model fit
initialization.seed_assignment: One initialization seed was assigned before the first experiments for each system and used throughout that prospective campaign.

acquisition.scope: All unselected candidates in the 13920-condition decision space
acquisition.batch_mode: Simultaneous top4; update after complete batch feedback
acquisition.tie_breaking: 13920 PCG64 uniform jitter draws scaled by 1e-12, stable argsort

model.type: Hierarchical Gaussian process with conjugate variance-scale update
model.standardization: Mean and population SD of the currently selected responses; scale=1 if SD<=1e-12

stopping.rule: At the first completed round with n>=24 and initial_SD>1e-12 and best(n)-best(n-8)<=0.1*initial_SD

execution.campaign_loop: Fit the surrogate to all UV responses available through the preceding completed round; recommend four conditions; run all four experiments; return the measured UV responses; then update the model.
execution.feedback: Only UV responses returned from completed experiments are assimilated; a partial batch is not used for an update.
execution.source_resolution: For repeated condition keys in the deposited response ledger, complete-condition-grid records take precedence over catalyst-panel records. No averaging or maximum-response selection.

post_run_verification.purpose: Recompute the single recorded campaign for each system and check the saved recommendations, returned UV responses, posterior quantities and first stopping decision.
post_run_verification.scope: Integrity verification of the recorded prospective campaign using the preassigned seed and the measured feedback available at each completed round.

method_reference.description: Prior GP-based reaction condition recommendation and random-screening comparison; current batch size, kernel and UCB settings are specified here.
